serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
I hope I will luck out and catch that cashier at her work.
Before finding {f_botName} I never had a sexbot or any bot for that matter.
They were expensive and I didn’t have enough money even for the cheapest one.
It’s not like I want to get that bot for myself or anything.
I just want {f_botName} to have a fellow bot to talk with and maybe meet with her owner.
Priestbot is also a bot, but I’m afraid he might have a bad influence on her.
Going to church with her is also kinda…
Besides all that, Priestbot is also a guy. {{wi}}I think? He’s a priest after all, although he lacks some very important parts of a man…
It would be good for {f_botName} to have a female bot friend she could talk to about…{{wi}} bot stuff? 
Whatever they talk about, I just hope they will talk like normal human beings instead of connecting through bluetooth, especially while outside.
Two girls that seem to be communicating telepathically might draw the attention of onlookers…
